IC1: Aged 25-80 at screening. Subjects older than 80 will be allowed at the discretion of the PI.
IC2: Ambulatory (defined as able to ambulate at least 10 meters, with or without assistance).
IC3: Clinical Diagnosis of PD based on the United Kingdom Brain Bank diagnostic criteria for PD.
IC4: At least 8 micturitions per 24 hours and
IC5: At least 3 urgency episodes per 3-day diary.
IC6: A MoCA score betw [OR]een 19 and 28 (inclusive) at screening. For those on cognitive enhancers (donepezil, riv [OR]astigmine, mem [OR]antine, gal [OR]antamine) a MoCA score between 19 and 29 (inclusive) at screening.
IC7: Provide informed consent to participate in the study and understand that they may withdraw their consent at any time without prejudice to their future medical care.
IC8: Be cognitively capable, in the opinion of investigator, to understand and provide such informed consent.
IC9: Be cognitively capable to complete the required questionnaires and assessments, OR have a care partner who is willing and capable to assist them in the completion of these tasks.
IC10: Be on a stable regimen of antiparkinson's medications at least 30 days prior to screening, and be expected to remain on a stable dose for the duration of the study.
IC11: If taking cognitive enhancers (donepezil, rivastig [OR]mine, memantin [OR]e, galantam [OR]ine), must be on stable dose at least 30 days prior to screening, and be expected to remain on a stable dose for the duration of the study.
